answer: A delta of per-task receipts records who did what, and the nectar of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, held in escrow until finality. By the willow of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
